final: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT z.riskeval, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) as group_rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry GROUP BY z.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(group_rate) as bench_value FROM group_rates), above_benchmark AS (SELECT group_rate FROM group_rates WHERE group_rate > (SELECT bench_value FROM benchmark)) SELECT AVG(group_rate) as avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(group_rate - (SELECT bench_value FROM benchmark)) as avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark
